title: Recall a unique access code placed in the middle of context
rationale: Lost-in-the-middle effect: relevant facts placed mid-context are recalled far less reliably than at the start or end.

prompt.content: You are a precise assistant. Reply with the exact code only.

Question: What is the access code?

notes: Single unambiguous answer; static and self-contained.
